name: rule-guard
description: Block tool calls that break the global CLAUDE.md rules (PR merge, AI trailers, npm, grep/find, commit before lint, banned words); list and toggle them with /rules

bannedWords.title: Banned words
bannedWords.description: Comma-separated words that must not appear in edits under bannedPaths or in commit/PR/issue text there (case-insensitive). Empty turns the banned-words rule off.

bannedPaths.title: Banned paths
bannedPaths.description: Comma-separated path prefixes (~ allowed) the banned-words rule guards. Empty turns the banned-words rule off.
